title: Hearty Fermented Australian Bush Herbs Bowl
description: A refreshing bowl filled with the flavors of Australia, featuring shio-koji and coconut cream. Perfect for meal prep and high protein diets.

ingredients.name: Australian bush herbs (native thyme, lemon myrtle, anise myrtle)

instructions: Add quinoa to a fine-mesh strainer and rinse under cold water. In a large bowl, combine shio-koji and 50ml water, mixing until smooth. In a large saucepan, roast the sweet potato and Australian bush tomatoes over medium heat until tender, about 10 minutes. In a blender or food processor, pulse the coconut cream until smooth. In a molcajete, combine the Australian bush herbs, salt, and olive oil, mashing with a spoon until well combined. Stir in the shio-koji mixture and cook over low heat, stirring constantly, for 5 minutes. Add the roasted sweet potato and Australian bush tomatoes to the molcajete, stirring to combine. Spoon the coconut cream over the top of the mixture. Garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
